reviews.title: 🙏 Much Gratitude
reviews.text:
How do you thank an App for literally saving your life multiple times? Immense value (bonus while
traveling solo!)!
Sugarmate calls to check in and to tell me when my glucose is low. Who does that for you? Consistently? What
if it was an off day? This is THE backup plan for those days and then some.

reviews.title: Since my iOS updated several weeks ago, my Sugarmate app crashes continuously.
reviews.text:
5/10/26 Many foods I try to enter crash the app and do not get saved.  I have given up on using Sugarmate for anything but a quick look at the carbs in foods so I can save it in my Dexcom app.  I had really loved using Sugarmate but constant glitches are too frustrating.  When I reached out for help, I was asked to share a video of my experience.  I am not tech savvy so this request was beyond what I could provide.  I used to tell everyone I knew to use Sugarmate as there are so many features.  Unfortunately, it keeps breaking so I am done.  😭
12/6/24 I am updating my review based on the new version.  I thought the earlier version was perfect and now I just want it back!  I use Apple iOS.  This new version is so jumbled that there is even writing overwritten into other writing so it is hard to read.  I am now limited to scrolling through my day’s Insulin and food intake at the bottom of the page so it is difficult to see my information.  I believe I lost my favorite foods that I had saved.  When I search for a food, I cannot read the details or see the photos that are handy.  Is there a way I can use the older version?  It is really hard to accept these changes that now make Sugarmate nearly impossible to use with any efficiency.

Older comments:
I have been so happy with Sugarmate as it offers me so many ways to document my information. From carbs to my medications, I can monitor so much in one spot and can make notes, too. Today, I have noticed that the app thinks it is Sunday, Dec. 26, 2001. Why is the date off? I reloaded the app but it still has the wrong date. I cannot find anywhere to fix it and my Dexcom app has the current date. Am I the only one?

reviews.title: Love this! But I definitely don’t use all the features to my full advantage!
reviews.text: I was very skeptical about using a third party app, when the original app for the dexcom worked great (I still use the g6 as of writing this on 5/6/26) but over the years I have heard nothing but wonders about Sugarmate that I decided to give it a try! And I am so glad I did!

reviews.title: A Shell of what it used to be
reviews.text:
I used to use this app extensively. It was a wonderfully developed app that took full advantage of what iOS had to offer. From shortcuts to Siri commands and easy data entry. After the redesign when purchased by Tandem it went down hill. They took away everything that makes the app good. No more shortcuts. The interface is harder to use and good bye Siri features. 

It literally takes me 5-10 minutes to enter my data now vs before I could do in seconds. So I stopped using the app because it was so cumbersome. 

If you just want a general log, this would be fine, but I can do the same thing using shortcuts and Apple Health faster and easier without some mega corporations having access to my data. After all that is the only reason why Tandem bought this app from the developer.

reviews.title: Disservice of time
reviews.text: I never write reviews if o don’t have anything nice to say. However, I have tried reaching support and it’s been a waste of time as much as trying to log into the app. I have done the deep IT into logging into the Dexcom on the browser without any issue and have the correct username and password and sugarmate continues with please trying again later something went wrong. You call tandem and they only support pump related issues. It’s devastating that everything that sugar mate promises can’t be accessed and can save life’s and also calm the deep back end of worries for our loved ones having to be monitored 24/7. I think the most upsetting is the waste, without any positive outcome.

reviews.title: App rewrite was a downgrade
reviews.text: I used the previous “legacy” version of Sugarmate extensively, and I loved how it felt like a diabetes app for power users. The deep integration with Siri Shortcuts was awesome, to the point where I had built custom shortcuts to help me quickly log food and calculate net carbs for my Omnipod. My numbers had never been better. The new, redesigned (read: dumbed-down) version of the app removed all of the Shortcuts integrations that I relied on and my custom automations completely broke. Major downgrade and actually affected my quality of life: I can literally see the change in my average glucose numbers after my shortcuts stopped working. One year later and I still haven’t found a viable replacement app. So, so disappointing.

reviews.title: Tweaks
reviews.text: So many things I like about the app. Maybe I missed it, but I don’t see a way to connect the app to my Apple Health data. My Dexcom app is connected so I don’t have to enter things in the app. I’m not willing to add data like bolus, exercise, etc. into your app. If there’s a way to connect my Health data to this app, please let me know!!

reviews.title: Not working out!
reviews.text:
At first I was super happy with this app and it was working great. I was even sleeping really good knowing the alarms were loud and I could actually hear them not now, it suddenly disconnects for days at a time and I can’t get it to work right. I’m in search of something else at the moment because sadly this isn’t working the way it should. Idk what went wrong but I was extremely happy with it until the last couple of weeks. 
UPDATE: it’s still the same sadly! I really had high hopes for this app. I’m not sure what goes wrong but it’s always disconnecting or logging me off without warning. If it wasn’t for that, I’d give it 5 stars because when it works, it works amazingly!!!!

reviews.text: After the update to iOS 26.0.1, I cannot sign into the app.  I continue to get the error message “Something went wrong. Please try again later.” Have used the app for years to track my son’s blood sugar. The app allows for better alerts for Follower, including fall rates and a higher threshold for the first “low” alert. I am alerted sooner when we’re starting to drop which gives us more time to intervene.   Hoping to get the sign in issue resolved soon.

reviews.title: App improvement
reviews.text: Pretty good app but could improve it by adding a carb insulin ratio or divider number when entering insulin. So it would be a calculater within the insulin amount entering. Carbs eaten divided by carbs insulin ratio equals number of units of insulin to be taken. 28 divided by 14 equals 2 units of insulin. Right now I have to leave the app, use the calculator and then go back to the app and enter the info. Hopefully this makes sense. Thanks

Since the last update the app drains my battery. It uses more battery than all the other apps combined.
It also isn’t working properly, it cycles every time I enter data and doesn’t stay up to date with my readings. I often have to close and reopen it to get it working properly.

reviews.title: Amazing

reviews.title: Widget?
reviews.text: The app is fine; I like it better than Dexcom Follow. But no widget is available on iOS 26. My research turned up something about WidgetKit compatibility since iOS 17? Anyway, would love to have a widget again for quick checks of my kid’s BG on the home screen. Git ‘er done, Sugarmate.
